## Introduction

This tracks how my days are going. Am I performing how I'd like? How is my sleep going?

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| include: false

# Import libraries
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from duckdb import query as qr

# Import custom data preparation functions
from src.data_cleaners import get_combined_data, get_sleep_data

# Get and prepare all data
habit_sleep_data = get_combined_data(
    email="jake.selvey@gmail.com",
    sheet_url="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/169r9jn66M-ij0Pj6eS7wV6q5jhE2vWUz5vhYCrcBLBA/edit?usp=sharing"
)

# Get sleep data separately for the sleep-specific chart
sleep_data = get_sleep_data()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-responsive: true

# 7 Day Personal Score Chart
# Sort data by date and take the most recent 7 days
last_seven_days = habit_sleep_data.sort_values(by='habit_date').tail(7)

# Create a stacked bar chart
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))
bar_width = 0.35
index = np.arange(len(last_seven_days))

# Create the stacked bars
bar1 = ax.bar(index, last_seven_days['morning'], bar_width, label='Morning', color='#60a5fa')
bar2 = ax.bar(index, last_seven_days['day'], bar_width, 
              bottom=last_seven_days['morning'], label='Day', color='#34d399')
bar3 = ax.bar(index, last_seven_days['evening'], bar_width,
              bottom=last_seven_days['morning'] + last_seven_days['day'], 
              label='Evening', color='#a78bfa')

# Add value labels for each segment
for i in range(len(last_seven_days)):
    # Morning label
    ax.text(i, last_seven_days['morning'].iloc[i]/2, 
            f"{last_seven_days['morning'].iloc[i]:.1f}", 
            ha='center', va='center', color='white')
    
    # Day label
    ax.text(i, last_seven_days['morning'].iloc[i] + last_seven_days['day'].iloc[i]/2,
            f"{last_seven_days['day'].iloc[i]:.1f}", 
            ha='center', va='center', color='white')
    
    # Evening label
    ax.text(i, last_seven_days['morning'].iloc[i] + last_seven_days['day'].iloc[i] + 
            last_seven_days['evening'].iloc[i]/2,
            f"{last_seven_days['evening'].iloc[i]:.1f}", 
            ha='center', va='center', color='white')
    
    # Total score label on top
    ax.text(i, last_seven_days['morning'].iloc[i] + last_seven_days['day'].iloc[i] + 
            last_seven_days['evening'].iloc[i] + 0.2,
            f"{last_seven_days['total_score'].iloc[i]:.1f}", 
            ha='center', va='bottom', color='black', fontweight='bold')

# Customize the plot
ax.set_xlabel('Date')
ax.set_ylabel('Scores')
ax.set_title('Personal Scores - Last Seven Days')
ax.set_xticks(index)

# Create date labels with both date and day of week
date_labels = [f"{d.strftime('%m/%d')}\n{d.strftime('%a')}" for d in last_seven_days['habit_date']]
ax.set_xticklabels(date_labels)

# Add legend with reversed handles and labels
handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax.legend(handles[::-1], labels[::-1], loc='upper right', bbox_to_anchor=(0.98, 0.98))

# Adjust layout to prevent label cutoff
plt.tight_layout()

# Display the plot
plt.show()
```



```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-responsive: true

##########   SLEEP LAST SEVEN DAYS
# Calculate rolling averages for all sleep data first and convert to hours
sleep_data['rolling_sleep_time_3d'] = sleep_data['total_sleep_time'].rolling(window=3, min_periods=1).mean() / 60
sleep_data['rolling_sleep_time_2d'] = sleep_data['total_sleep_time'].rolling(window=2, min_periods=1).mean() / 60

# Then get last 7 days of data
last_seven_sleep = sleep_data.sort_values(by='day_of_date').tail(7)

# Convert out_of_bed_time to hours since midnight for plotting
def time_to_decimal_hours(time_obj):
    if pd.isna(time_obj):
        return None
    return time_obj.hour + time_obj.minute / 60

wake_times = last_seven_sleep['out_of_bed_time'].apply(time_to_decimal_hours)

# Create figure with two y-axes
fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6))
ax2 = ax1.twinx()

# Set bar width and positions
bar_width = 0.35
index = np.arange(len(last_seven_sleep))

# Create the bars for sleep scores (left axis)
bars = ax1.bar(index, last_seven_sleep['sleep_score'], bar_width, 
               color='#60a5fa', alpha=0.7, label='Sleep Score')

# Offset the dots for wake times to appear between the ticks
offset_index = index + bar_width / 2

# Create the line for wake times (right axis) with offset
line = ax2.plot(offset_index, wake_times, color='#f472b6', 
                marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, 
                label='Wake Time', zorder=5)

# Add value labels on top of each bar
for i in range(len(last_seven_sleep)):
    if not pd.isna(last_seven_sleep['sleep_score'].iloc[i]):
        # Format sleep score label
        sleep_score = last_seven_sleep['sleep_score'].iloc[i]
        ax1.text(i, sleep_score + 2,
                f"{sleep_score:.0f}", 
                ha='center', va='bottom', color='#1d4ed8', fontweight='bold')
    
    # Add sleep time labels with both rolling averages
    if not pd.isna(last_seven_sleep['total_sleep_time'].iloc[i]):
        total_sleep = last_seven_sleep['total_sleep_time'].iloc[i] / 60
        rolling_sleep_3d = last_seven_sleep['rolling_sleep_time_3d'].iloc[i]
        rolling_sleep_2d = last_seven_sleep['rolling_sleep_time_2d'].iloc[i]
        ax1.text(i, sleep_score - 10,
                f"Last Night: {total_sleep:.1f}h\n2-day avg: {rolling_sleep_2d:.1f}h\n3-day avg: {rolling_sleep_3d:.1f}h",
                ha='center', va='top', color='#1d4ed8', fontsize=8)

# Add wake time labels with offset
for i, time in enumerate(wake_times):
    if not pd.isna(time):
        hours = int(time)
        minutes = int((time - hours) * 60)
        ax2.text(offset_index[i], time + 0.15, 
                f"{hours:02d}:{minutes:02d}",
                ha='center', va='bottom', color='#be185d', fontweight='bold')

# Customize the left axis (sleep score)
ax1.set_xlabel('Date')
ax1.set_ylabel('Sleep Score', color='#1d4ed8')
ax1.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#1d4ed8')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 100)
ax1.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Customize the right axis (wake time)
ax2.set_ylabel('Wake Time', color='#be185d')
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#be185d')
ax2.set_ylim(5, 10)
y2_ticks = range(5, 11)
ax2.set_yticks(y2_ticks)
ax2.set_yticklabels([f"{int(h):02d}:00" for h in y2_ticks])

# Set title and x-axis
plt.title('Sleep Scores and Wake Times - Last Seven Days', pad=20)
ax1.set_xticks(index)

# Create date labels with both date and day of week
date_labels = [f"{d.strftime('%m/%d')}\n{d.strftime('%a')}" for d in last_seven_sleep['day_of_date']]
ax1.set_xticklabels(date_labels)

# Combine legends
lines1, labels1 = ax1.get_legend_handles_labels()
lines2, labels2 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax1.legend(lines1 + lines2, labels1 + labels2, 
          loc='upper right', bbox_to_anchor=(1.15, 1.1))

# Adjust layout to prevent label cutoff
plt.tight_layout()

# Display the plot
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-responsive: true

##########         WEEKLY SLEEP SCORES      #########
# Get complete days and calculate week starts
complete_days = habit_sleep_data[habit_sleep_data[['morning', 'day', 'evening']].notna().all(axis=1)]
complete_days['week_start'] = complete_days['habit_date'] - pd.to_timedelta(complete_days['day_of_week'], unit='D')

# Calculate weekly averages for complete days only
weekly_averages = complete_days.groupby('week_start').agg({
    'morning': 'mean',
    'day': 'mean', 
    'evening': 'mean',
    'total_score': 'mean',
    'habit_date': 'count'  # Count of complete days per week
}).round(1)

weekly_averages = weekly_averages.sort_index()

# Create plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6))
bar_width = 0.35
index = np.arange(len(weekly_averages))

# Create stacked bars
bar1 = ax.bar(index, weekly_averages['morning'], bar_width, label='Morning', color='#60a5fa')
bar2 = ax.bar(index, weekly_averages['day'], bar_width, 
              bottom=weekly_averages['morning'], label='Day', color='#34d399')
bar3 = ax.bar(index, weekly_averages['evening'], bar_width,
              bottom=weekly_averages['morning'] + weekly_averages['day'], 
              label='Evening', color='#a78bfa')

# Add value labels for each segment
for i in range(len(weekly_averages)):
    # Morning label
    if not pd.isna(weekly_averages['morning'].iloc[i]):
        ax.text(i, weekly_averages['morning'].iloc[i]/2, 
                f"{weekly_averages['morning'].iloc[i]:.1f}", 
                ha='center', va='center', color='white')
    
    # Day label
    if not pd.isna(weekly_averages['day'].iloc[i]):
        ax.text(i, weekly_averages['morning'].iloc[i] + weekly_averages['day'].iloc[i]/2,
                f"{weekly_averages['day'].iloc[i]:.1f}", 
                ha='center', va='center', color='white')
    
    # Evening label
    if not pd.isna(weekly_averages['evening'].iloc[i]):
        ax.text(i, weekly_averages['morning'].iloc[i] + weekly_averages['day'].iloc[i] + 
                weekly_averages['evening'].iloc[i]/2,
                f"{weekly_averages['evening'].iloc[i]:.1f}", 
                ha='center', va='center', color='white')
    
    # Total score label on top (only if all components present)
    if not pd.isna(weekly_averages['total_score'].iloc[i]):
        ax.text(i, weekly_averages['morning'].iloc[i] + weekly_averages['day'].iloc[i] + 
                weekly_averages['evening'].iloc[i] + 0.2,
                f"{weekly_averages['total_score'].iloc[i]:.1f}", 
                ha='center', va='bottom', color='black', fontweight='bold')

# Customize plot
ax.set_xlabel('Week Starting')
ax.set_ylabel('Average Scores')
ax.set_title('Average Weekly Scores (Complete Days Only)')
ax.set_xticks(index)

# Date labels
date_labels = [d.strftime('%m/%d') for d in weekly_averages.index]
ax.set_xticklabels(date_labels, rotation=45, ha='right')

# Add count of complete days per week
days_text = "Complete days per week: " + ", ".join([f"{date_labels[i]}: {count}" 
                                                  for i, count in enumerate(weekly_averages['habit_date'])])
plt.figtext(0.5, -0.05, days_text, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8)

# Legend
handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax.legend(handles[::-1], labels[::-1], loc='upper right', bbox_to_anchor=(0.98, 0.98))

# Grid and layout
ax.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.3)
plt.subplots_adjust(bottom=0.2)

plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false

######    AVG SLEEP SCORES BY DAY OF WEEK   ############
# Calculate daily averages, but only include rows where all components are present
complete_days = habit_sleep_data[habit_sleep_data[['morning', 'day', 'evening']].notna().all(axis=1)]
daily_averages = complete_days.groupby('day_of_week').agg({
    'morning': 'mean',
    'day': 'mean',
    'evening': 'mean',
    'total_score': 'mean'
}).round(1)

# Sort by day of week
daily_averages = daily_averages.reindex(range(7))

# Create figure and axis
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))
bar_width = 0.35
index = np.arange(len(daily_averages))

# Create stacked bars
bar1 = ax.bar(index, daily_averages['morning'], bar_width, label='Morning', color='#60a5fa')
bar2 = ax.bar(index, daily_averages['day'], bar_width, 
              bottom=daily_averages['morning'], label='Day', color='#34d399')
bar3 = ax.bar(index, daily_averages['evening'], bar_width,
              bottom=daily_averages['morning'] + daily_averages['day'], 
              label='Evening', color='#a78bfa')

# Add value labels for each segment
for i in range(len(daily_averages)):
    # Morning label
    if not pd.isna(daily_averages['morning'].iloc[i]):
        ax.text(i, daily_averages['morning'].iloc[i]/2, 
                f"{daily_averages['morning'].iloc[i]:.1f}", 
                ha='center', va='center', color='white')
    
    # Day label
    if not pd.isna(daily_averages['day'].iloc[i]):
        ax.text(i, daily_averages['morning'].iloc[i] + daily_averages['day'].iloc[i]/2,
                f"{daily_averages['day'].iloc[i]:.1f}", 
                ha='center', va='center', color='white')
    
    # Evening label
    if not pd.isna(daily_averages['evening'].iloc[i]):
        ax.text(i, daily_averages['morning'].iloc[i] + daily_averages['day'].iloc[i] + 
                daily_averages['evening'].iloc[i]/2,
                f"{daily_averages['evening'].iloc[i]:.1f}", 
                ha='center', va='center', color='white')
    
    # Total score label on top (only if all components present)
    if not pd.isna(daily_averages['total_score'].iloc[i]):
        ax.text(i, daily_averages['morning'].iloc[i] + daily_averages['day'].iloc[i] + 
                daily_averages['evening'].iloc[i] + 0.2,
                f"{daily_averages['total_score'].iloc[i]:.1f}", 
                ha='center', va='bottom', color='black', fontweight='bold')

# Customize plot
ax.set_xlabel('Day of Week')
ax.set_ylabel('Average Scores')
ax.set_title('Average Daily Scores by Day of Week')
ax.set_xticks(index)

# Create day labels
day_labels = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun']
ax.set_xticklabels(day_labels)

# Add count of complete days for each day of week
day_counts = complete_days.groupby('day_of_week').size()
counts_text = "Complete days per weekday: " + ", ".join([f"{day_labels[day]}: {count}" for day, count in day_counts.items()])
plt.figtext(0.5, -0.05, counts_text, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8)

# Add legend
handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax.legend(handles[::-1], labels[::-1], loc='upper right', bbox_to_anchor=(0.98, 0.98))

# Add gridlines
ax.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout
plt.subplots_adjust(bottom=0.2)

plt.show()
```
